description: This file defines the StreamInterface interface, which describes a data stream abstraction for PSR-7 HTTP message handling. It specifies methods for reading, writing, seeking, and retrieving metadata from a stream.

classes.name: StreamInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the operations for a data stream, including reading, writing, seeking, and serialization functionalities.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the entire stream content to a string, reading from the beginning to the end.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream and any associated resources.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the underlying PHP stream resource from the object.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position of the file pointer.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the pointer is at the end of the stream.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Determines if the stream supports seeking.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Seeks to a specified position in the stream.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Seeks to the beginning of the stream.

methods.name: isWritable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is writable.

methods.name: isReadable
methods.description: Checks if the stream is readable.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Returns the remaining contents of the stream as a string.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Retrieves stream metadata or a specific key.
